page.layout: One printed page on the right side of the scan (its text runs to the right edge, mostly cut off); the large left area is a blank page with no text. Right page: a title block at the top, a short heading and paragraph text in the left portion of the right page, and fragments of marginal notes along the inner (left) margin of the right page.
page.notes: The left page is blank. The right page is heavily damaged: the outer part of each line is cut off by the edge of the scan, so most lines are fragments and are given only as far as legible. Lines are read from the visible fragments only; the exact words are uncertain and are not reconstructed. Marginal fragments on the inner edge are likely notes but cannot be read reliably.
